fact: PURA stated in January 2022 that the Gambia's international communications run mainly over the ACE cable, and that operators, as required, bought backup bandwidth on the Sonatel fibre via Senegal (Amdalaye to Selete) which kept customers connected during an ACE fault.
title: PURA EXPLAINS FREQUENT FIBRE CUTS AND PLANS TO EXPLORE SECURING SECOND FIBRE CABLE AND EXTRA BACKUP FACILITIES
